brief: Is meant to hold a grid of rows and columns with a current cell that moves, but no object of it can be built today.
detail: The class wraps the engine's grid navigation module: a position, moves that refuse to leave the grid, a neighbour count, a validity test and a Manhattan distance. Today new stzGridNav always raises Can't create stzGridNav! Engine returned error, because the wrapper hands the engine a grid name that the engine does not take, so every row and column is read one argument too late; the direction constants of the class also disagree with the engine's. The engine functions themselves work when called directly with their own arguments, as StzEngineGridCreate(3, 4).
